correctness.rationale: Exactly specify uniform Dirichlet m-gap null, all m>=2 and thresholds 0<=t<=1. k-subset simplex shift yields conditional quadratic moment and F_m,A_m via inclusion-exclusion; beta integrations and binomial harmonic identities give E[M G]. Marginal second/fourth moments give variance and correlation; B_m increment 2(H_m-1)/m>0 supplies all-m sign; harmonic asymptotics justify the rate. Independently performed exact polynomial integration at m=3 and 2760 verifier assertions from current package source path; finite checks not used as infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Four implication-level checks were performed. The nearest inspected sources give unweighted maximum-spacing laws, marginal quadratic-spacing moments, or maximum-gap asymptotics; none of their inspected theorems specifies the present weighted threshold moment, exact cross covariance, or correlation scale. The old shortest-gap quadratic regression is not stronger because conditioning on the largest gap requires overlapping threshold events and different sign behavior. Older inaccessible full texts remain a documented risk, not proof of historical priority.
residual_risks: A classical or specialized source might contain equivalent mixed moment identities under broken-stick or periodogram terminology; historical priority cannot be certified by search alone.
Pyke (1965) full text was not available; only publisher metadata and an indexed excerpt were inspected.
Huffer full text was not read; its abstract concerns linear-combination distributions, so an unsuspected quadratic extension cannot be ruled out.

value.rationale: The largest gap and Greenwood quadratic spacing sum represent complementary maximum-gap and global-unevenness diagnostics in goodness-of-fit and normalized periodogram settings. An exact threshold-truncated first quadratic moment for all t, strictly positive finite covariance, and explicit slowly decaying correlation constitute a motivated joint-law improvement beyond either marginal. The result does not assert combined-test critical values or asymptotic independence.
